name: Pit Wall
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Your F1 pit wall in the Omarchy bar: next-session countdown that flips to live timing when the lights go out.

barWidget.description: Bar pill counts down to the next F1 session and goes live during one. The panel carries the full weekend schedule in your local time, the live leaderboard with gaps, and both championship standings.

schema.label: Hide pill until 24h before a session
schema.description: When On, the bar slot collapses outside race weekends and reappears a day before the next session.
